name: How Can I Avoid Common Kitchen Remodeling Delays?

step.name: Step 1
step.text: It's the big question on everyone's mind: how do you keep your kitchen remodel on schedule? While a little disruption is inevitable, major delays often stem from a few common, and avoidable, missteps. The single biggest mistake is starting demolition before every single material and finish has been selected and ordered. It's tempting to get going, but waiting for backordered cabinets or appliances can bring your entire project to a screeching halt.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: Another frequent issue is not fully understanding the permit and inspection timeline in Los Angeles County. These steps are there for your safety, but they can add weeks to the process if not planned for properly. Finally, always have a contingency plan. Unforeseen issues, like finding old plumbing that needs updating, can pop up once walls are opened. A good plan and a solid budget account for these surprises from the start.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: When your project involves moving walls, changing layouts, or significant plumbing and electrical work, having an experienced partner is key. A professional design/build team manages all these moving parts—from ordering materials to scheduling inspections—to ensure a smoother process.
